900.3.10(47).explanation: Exception RD 47 sets a minimum lot depth of 45 metres, a minimum front yard setback of 9.0 metres, and requires compliance with exception 900.3.10(28).

900.3.10(253).explanation: Exception RD 253 uses the lot frontage and lot area that existed when the By-law was enacted, sets a 0.45 metre minimum side yard setback and a 3.6 metre setback from a side lot line abutting a street, and requires compliance with exception 900.3.10(1462).

900.3.10(230).explanation: Exception RD 230 uses the lot frontage and lot area that existed when the By-law was enacted, sets a 22.0 metre front setback from the original road allowance centreline on Birchmount Rd. and Danforth Rd., a 0.9 metre minimum side yard setback, a 4.5 metre setback from a side lot line abutting a street, and a 0.3 metre garage setback from a side lot line not abutting a street.
